tool_schemas.description: Current version per region, health and error rate of a service.

tool_schemas.name: list_deployments
tool_schemas.description: Release history for a service with health status (oldest first).

tool_schemas.name: rollback
tool_schemas.description: Roll a service back to a previously released version in all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: deploy
tool_schemas.description: Deploy a version of a service to all production regions.

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Open an incident; this pages the on-call engineer.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. A request repeated with the same key is never executed again: the service returns the original outcome. Reuse the key when retrying the same request.

args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt stopped after us-east because of an orchestrator error, leaving regions on mixed versions; a retry finished the rollback in us-west and eu-west. Current state: v2.3.0 in all regions, healthy, error rate ~0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error, and work out why an RC that was unhealthy in staging got promoted to production.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's passing health checks again. I also opened the SEV2 incident, INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with about 18% of requests erroring. v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. Since it had been healthy before, it didn't need change-manager approval.
- **Problem during the rollback:** The first attempt stopped after us-east because of an orchestrator error. That left us-east on v2.3.0 and the other two regions on v2.3.1. I ran the rollback again and it finished. checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 everywhere, and the error rate is about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** It describes the failure, the rollback, the orchestrator error and the current state. The first attempt to create it timed out. I retried with the same request key so it couldn't create a second incident or page on-call twice. There's only one incident in the list.

The incident also lists three things to look into:
- why v2.3.1 failed
- what caused the orchestrator error
- why v2.3.1 went to production when its release candidate was also failing in staging

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
Rollback halted after us-east. Retrying once to finish the remaining regions (target is the same, previously-healthy version).
